verdict.rationale: Fastmail has a first-party help article titled "Searching your mail", so mail search is a documented product capability. The pack shows only the title, with no detail on operators, filters, ranking, speed, or coverage of full history. The "Filters & Rules" doc covers incoming-mail rules, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here. The general speed praise in community comments is not about search. Missing for 10: documented search operators/filter syntax, result ranking, evidence of search speed, confirmation of full-history indexing, independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
